piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Persuasion and rhetorical devices
texto: Contextual reading of a classic speech or model opinion article on oratorical ethics and civic deliberation: read how the speaker dismantles the audience's scepticism by first validating its fears before setting out the collective advantages of the project. Notice the lexical richness and the balance between passionate conviction and scrupulous respect for the opponent.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การตั้งคำถามเชิงวาทศิลป์ช่วยกระตุ้นให้ผู้ฟังคิดไตร่ตรองและค้นหาคำตอบด้วยตนเอง» express?

opciones.texto: Rhetorical questions prompt the listener to reflect on their own certainties.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การตั้งคำถามเชิงวาทศิลป์ช่วยกระตุ้นให้ผู้ฟังคิดไตร่ตรองและค้นหาคำตอบด้วยตนเอง» from the text.

opciones.texto: Ordering arguments from the weakest to the strongest builds persuasive force.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: The ultimate goal of persuasive communication is to build understanding and lasting cooperation.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.
โน้มน้าว means «to persuade».
